proof_body:
by
  intro K _ _ h2 h0
  have h1 := NumberField.InfinitePlace.card_add_two_mul_card_eq_rank K
  have h3 := NumberField.InfinitePlace.card_eq_nrRealPlaces_add_nrComplexPlaces (K := K)
  have h4 := NumberField.Units.finrank_eq K
  have hr : NumberField.Units.rank K = 1 := by
    rw [NumberField.Units.rank]; omega
  by_contra hcon
  push Not at hcon
  have hz : Module.finrank ℤ (Additive (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)ˣ) = 0 := by
    rw [Module.finrank_eq_zero_iff]
    intro x
    obtain ⟨n, hn, hx⟩ := hcon (Additive.toMul x)
    refine ⟨n, by omega, ?_⟩
    have : (n : ℤ) • x = Additive.ofMul ((Additive.toMul x) ^ n) := by simp
    rw [this, hx]; rfl
  omega
target_source: ∀ (K : Type*) [Field K] [NumberField K], Module.finrank ℚ K = 2 → NumberField.InfinitePlace.nrComplexPlaces K = 0 → ∃ u : (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)ˣ, ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → u ^ n ≠ 1
